# India Essential Oils

> Premier WHO-GMP and ISO 22000 certified manufacturer, steam distillation distillery, and direct global bulk exporter of 100% pure, GC-MS authenticated essential oils, cold-pressed carrier oils, floral absolutes, spice oils, and Ayurvedic botanical extracts based in New Delhi, India.

## Organization & Authority
- **Company Name**: India Essential Oils
- **Parent Enterprise**: Mother Herbs Private Limited (Established 2004)
- **Headquarters**: New Delhi, India
- **Website**: https://indiaessentialoils.com
- **Industry Class**: Botanical Oil Manufacturer, Steam Distiller & Bulk Exporter
- **Global Export Reach**: 45+ countries (United States, European Union, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Australia, Japan, Canada)
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: 1 kg for trial batches; up to 200 kg drum wholesale consignments
- **Lead Times & Dispatch**: 24–48 hours dispatch from New Delhi international cargo hub

## Key Analytical Purity & Certifications
- **GC-MS Batch Testing**: Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS) analysis conducted on 100% of production lots to verify active chemical constituents and ensure zero adulteration, phthalates, synthetic fragrance boosters, or heavy metals.
- **Batch Verification Tool**: https://indiaessentialoils.com/batch-lookup (instant online lookup for CoA, GC-MS spectra, density, and optical rotation by batch code).
- **Accreditations**:
  - ISO 22000:2005 (Food Safety Management System)
  - ISO 9001:2008 (Quality Management System)
  - WHO-GMP Certified (Good Manufacturing Practice)
  - FSSAI Approved (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India)
  - IndiaMART TrustSeal Verified Exporter

## Core Product Categories
1. **100% Pure Essential Oils**: Lavender (*Lavandula angustifolia*), Peppermint (*Mentha piperita*), Tea Tree (*Melaleuca alternifolia*), Eucalyptus (*Eucalyptus globulus*), Frankincense (*Boswellia serrata*), Sandalwood (*Santalum album*), Rosemary (*Rosmarinus officinalis*), Ylang Ylang (*Cananga odorata*), Patchouli (*Pogostemon cablin*), Bergamot, Lemongrass, etc.
2. **Authentic Spice Essential Oils**: Black Pepper, Cardamom, Clove Bud, Cinnamon Bark, Turmeric, Ginger, Cumin, Nutmeg, Coriander Seed.
3. **Cold-Pressed Carrier & Base Oils**: Jojoba, Virgin Coconut, Moroccan Argan, Rosehip Seed, Castor, Sweet Almond, Evening Primrose, Neem Seed.
4. **Floral Absolutes & Concentrates**: Jasmine Grandiflorum, Rose Damascena, Lotus, Champaca, Tuberose.
5. **Therapeutic Hydrosols (Floral Waters)**: Pure Rose Water, Lavender Hydrosol, Neroli Distillate, Tea Tree Water.
6. **Natural Oleoresins**: Capsicum, Black Pepper, Turmeric Curcumin, Ginger, Paprika.
7. **USDA / EU Certified Organic Oils**: Organic Peppermint, Organic Lavender, Organic Tea Tree, Organic Frankincense.
8. **Ayurvedic Herbal Formulations**: Kumkumadi Tailam, Bhringraj Oil, Ashwagandha Infusion, Mahanarayan Oil, Triphala Oil.

## Packaging & Export Logistics
- **Containers**: 1 kg aluminium bottles, 5 kg HDPE canisters, 25 kg fluorinated carboys, 200 kg epoxy-lined steel drums.
- **Documentation**: Certificate of Analysis (CoA), Safety Data Sheet (MSDS), Gas Chromatography (GC-MS) Report, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary Certificate, Technical Data Sheet (TDS).
- **Shipping Modes**: Express Air Cargo (DHL/FedEx/Air Freight) and LCL/FCL Ocean Freight with IATA/ICAO compliant Hazmat packing.
